mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_outbox_event (id, aggregate_type, aggregate_ref, event_type, payload_json, status) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{event.id}), #{event.aggregateType}, #{event.aggregateRef}, #{event.eventType}, CAST(#{event.payloadJson} AS JSON), 'NEW')
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(id) AS id, aggregate_type AS aggregateType, aggregate_ref AS aggregateRef, event_type AS eventType, JSON_SERIALIZE(payload_json RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000)) AS payloadJson, retry_count AS retryCount, status FROM edudoc_outbox_event WHERE status = 'NEW' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= SYSTIMESTAMP) ORDER BY create_time FETCH FIRST #{batchSize} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_outbox_event SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{id}) AND status = 'NEW'
UPDATE edudoc_outbox_event SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = SYSTIMESTAMP + NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{delaySeconds}, 'SECOND') WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{id}) AND status = 'NEW'
UPDATE edudoc_outbox_event SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1 WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{id}) AND status = 'NEW'
